notes.title: 27 June Update Notes
notes.content:
Fixes:
- Fixed laser visibility in third person
- Fixed uncrouch not possible on clients
- Fixed crouching animation when a player joins a session and there is already someone crouching in.

Global:
- Added blue laser to X12 pistol

Improvements:
- Improved performance and code 
- Improved map layout for 2vs2 map.

notes.title: 26 June Update Notes
notes.content:
Fixes:
- Fixed player not able to slide when high ping (not optimal).
- Fixed weapon visibility when high ping.
- Fixed maximum bot numbers.
- Fixed weird bots movement.

Global:
- Added 2vs2 gamemode, plays in 6 round.

Improvements:
- Cleaned code -> 1 or 2 fps boost.

notes.title: 25 June Update Notes Bis
notes.content:
Fixes :
- Fixed ability to do glitches in stairs.
- Fixed ability to do glitches in mid-map ramp.
- Fixed a bug where the player couldn't change weapon in third person
- Fixed float score in leaderboard.

Global
- Added settings to toggle / hold aiming.
- Added settings to toggle / hold crouching.
- Added interpolation for clients movement (not optimal yet).
- Added settings for inpsect key.

Know bugs
- Due to ping on clients there is a small delay where you can see the first person weapon in third person.
- Clients rotation are not fully replicated which can cause a really disturbing effect.

notes.title: 25 June Update Notes
notes.content:
Fixes :
- Fixed references in code -> 1 or 2 FPS boost.
- Fixed client not able to slide correctly.
- Fixed client rotation.
- Fixed client able to see mag reserve.
- Fixed NetCode in general
- Fixed missing node on MK-300A weapon.
- Fixed ability to melee while aiming instead of tac-stance.

notes.title: 24 June Update Notes
notes.content:
Fixes :
- Fixed references in code -> 1 or 2 FPS boost.
- Fixed wrong material on sniper's bipod.

Improvements :
- Added "Early access" text on menu screen.
- Improved iron-sight visibility for VPR-7X and A9-XW.

Global :
Weapon names :
    - Renamed Superi 60 to VPR-7X.
    - Renamed AG11W to A9-XW.
    - Renamed MK.24 to MK-300A.
    - Renamed HVG7 to HV-G7.

Camos :
    - Created default skin for VPR-7X.
    - Modified emissive color for A9-XW's camo.

notes.title: 23 June Updates Notes
notes.content:
Fixes :
- Fixed an issue that caused the game to not start on space pressed.
- Fixed an issue that caused bots to no be able to shot their weapons on first spawn.
- Fixed an issue where the player couldn't change his moving bindings from ZQSD to WASD.

Improvements :
- Improved INTRO animation.

Global :
- Boosted performance on light for FFA map.
- Changed camo on AG14W assault rifle.
- Updated magazine capacity for AG14W assault rifle : 30 to 35 rounds.

notes.title: 22 June Updates Notes Bis
notes.content:
Fixes :
- Fixed an issue that caused the player to be able to pickup only one weapon and then couldn't change it.
- Fixed an issue that caused the player to destroy his own weapons when picking up other things.

Improvements :
- Improved visual recoil for AG14W assault rifle.

Global :
- Nerfed SP60 sub machine gun's damage because of too much damage in the arms.
- Nerfed MK24 sniper rifle's damage because of ability to oneshot in legs.
- Nerfed MK24 sniper rifle's fire rate : 61 to 54 RPM

notes.title: 22 June Update Notes
notes.content:
Fixes:
- Sniper scope being not replicated on clients.
- Character's rotation being not correctly reset to zero after performing slides.
- Bots not shooting on their first spawn.

Know Bugs:
- Rocket launcher's rocket being not replicated on clients (temporary fix : disabled for now.)
- Bots are too strong in Free-For-All gamemode.
- Steam controller inputs override in-game ones so you need to setup steam controller inputs.
